rules.formula: Each class level gained at character level > 20 gives +0.5 BAB and +0.5 to each save, whatever the class table says. Fractions are summed across classes and rounded down once.
Per level: 3/4 of the hit die (d12 -> 9, d4 -> 3).
XP needed for level n = n * (n - 1) / 2 * 1000
